load_model: load model parameters from a root directory by model name with optional standard deviation bounds
make_model_params_from_iterables: make a list of layer parameters from raw parameter iterables for neural network layers
load_pickled_model: load a pickled neural network model from internal model paths and return processed parameters
load_proba_safety_model: load a Bayesian neural network model from the Probabilistic Safety paper with uncertainty bounds
build_model_params_from_raw: build model parameters from raw iterables including fully connected and convolutional layer definitions
